# Independent adversarial proof audit: positive latent-Ising compiler

Recognize strictly POSITIVE rank-two real CP with invertible legs,global balanced ferromagnetic labels,and componentwise CONSISTENT fields after unique positive symmetrization. Local pencil t in{0,1,-1},quadratic algebraic directions and exact positivity tests. Rejection or UNKNOWN outside domain is not hardness or exhaustion of other representations.
provides: Under consistent fields,random-cluster comparison bounds strong-edge disagreement by1/(beta+1). Conditioning and contraction preserve stated normalized law and collect every internal edge factor.
Subdivision identity sum_z t^([su=z]+[z=sv])=2t beta^[su=sv] requires reciprocal partition prefactor. A second rationalization and original exact normalization approximation are separately paid.

Known general consistent-field mixing theorem is used with inverse-polynomial coupling margin;near-linear fixed-margin theorem is not asserted uniformly. Edge annealing avoids inconsistent-field self-reduction.

costs: Polynomial BIT cost in raw rational encoding,n,m,1/epsilon and counting confidence. Bounded original degree keeps local algebraic degree bounded;no global compositum. Factorwise logarithmic errors sum,positive products do not cancel. Delete beta<1+eta;contract strong edges beta>M with Pr(disagree)<=1/(beta+1) ONLY under consistent fields. Collect ALL internal constants and multiply fields. Subdivide each parallel edge through its own auxiliary vertex,then recover pre-subdivision partition by DIVIDING product(2t),t=beta+sqrt(beta^2-1). SECOND rationalization of these new roots has its own error budget/lower margin. Edge-free cases direct. Expected-time exact rational coins are NOT worst-case bounded;cap retries perQ calls at ceil(log2(Q/gamma))+1 and charge failure/TV. Annealing adds min(2,t_final),doubles tofinal with ratiosin[1,2],paid independent approximate draws;no inconsistent-field pinning.
